test_modes.name: BMCR Loopback (bit 0.14)
test_modes.purpose: PHY internal MII / GMII transmit-path → receive-path loopback. Receive circuit isolated from medium; MAC TX_EN must result in RX_DV within 512 BT.

test_modes.name: BMCR Isolate (bit 0.10)
test_modes.purpose: Force MII / GMII data signals to high-impedance for multi-PHY board test or hot-insertion staging.

test_modes.name: BMCR Collision Test (bit 0.7)
test_modes.purpose: Force PHY to assert COL within 512 BT of TX_EN assertion to exercise the half-duplex collision path.

test_modes.name: BMCR Power Down (bit 0.11)
test_modes.purpose: Low-power state; MDIO still responsive — useful for board-level power-sequencing test.

test_modes.name: MS Test Mode (1000BASE-T reg 9.15:13)
test_modes.purpose: 1000BASE-T test modes 1-4: distortion / jitter / waveform / wander measurement at the MDI.

test_modes.name: AutoNeg Restart (BMCR bit 0.9)
test_modes.purpose: Re-run AutoNeg to verify state-machine restart + Base-Page exchange behavior.

test_modes.name: Vendor-specific BIST register
test_modes.purpose: Many silicon PHYs add a built-in self-test mode in registers 16-31 (Clause 22) or vendor-specific MMDs (Clause 45 DEVAD 30-31).

spec_provided_observability.name: Per-VL Sequence-Number state
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Observe the transmit/receive Sequence Number per Virtual Link for redundancy debug.

spec_provided_observability.name: Integrity-Check counters (per network)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Count accepted vs rejected frames on Network A and Network B independently.

spec_provided_observability.name: Redundancy-Management duplicate discards
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Count first-valid-wins duplicate discards to confirm both networks are delivering.

spec_provided_observability.name: Switch policing drops (per VL)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Count frames dropped by traffic policing to detect a babbling / over-rate VL.

spec_provided_observability.name: Sampling-port freshness
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Per sampling port, a fresh/stale indication and validity timeout.

spec_provided_observability.name: Queuing-port depth / overflow
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Observe FIFO occupancy and overflow on lossless queuing ports.

error_detection_mechanisms: Ethernet FCS (CRC-32) detects bit errors on each network.
Per-network Integrity Checking detects out-of-window Sequence Numbers.
Traffic policing at the switch detects/limits over-rate VLs.
Sampling-port validity timeout detects stale data.
Loss of one network is detected by the absence of one redundant copy (handled transparently by Redundancy Management).

interrupt_or_event_sources.trigger: BMSR bit 1.2 transitions 1→0 (link down) or 0→1 (link up) — many PHYs route this to an open-drain INT# pin.
BMSR bit 1.5 transitions to 1 after AutoNeg finishes.
10BASE-T jabber timer expiration; BMSR bit 1.1 set.
Vendor-specific Energy Efficient Ethernet wake event (Clause 78).
MAC Control sublayer recognises a valid 0x8808 / opcode 0x0001 frame; MAC stalls TX for the indicated pause quanta.
Half-duplex MAC TX FSM aborts after 16 retries — raises a MAC-error indication.
Per-frame error indication from the receive MAC.

loopback_modes_summary.name: Near-end MAC loopback
loopback_modes_summary.scope: MAC TX → MAC RX inside the MAC; PHY not exercised.

loopback_modes_summary.name: PCS loopback (BMCR 0.14)
loopback_modes_summary.scope: MII / GMII TX path → MII / GMII RX path inside the PHY; medium not driven.

loopback_modes_summary.name: PMA / PMD loopback
loopback_modes_summary.scope: Vendor-specific; loops back on the analog side of the PHY (e.g. after the MLT-3 encoder).

loopback_modes_summary.name: External cable loopback
loopback_modes_summary.scope: Physical RJ-45 / fiber loopback plug at the MDI; exercises the entire TX + RX analog chain.

notes: AFDX observability centers on per-VL Sequence-Number / Integrity-Check / Redundancy-Management counters at the End System and per-VL policing counters at the AFDX Switch, plus communication-port freshness/occupancy. The static offline configuration makes the expected timing/bandwidth deterministic and therefore verifiable.
